$comment: Guideline registry for every clinical rule set in AMISE MedFlow (iOS, web, API, front desk). One entry per rule set in docs/CLINICAL-CONTENT-INVENTORY.md. Checked in CI by scripts/src/lint-guideline-registry.ts: a missing file or an unregistered known rule-set file fails; an unknown lastReviewed or a passed nextReviewDue only warns. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (America/St_Lucia) or "unknown". lastReviewed records a documented CLINICAL review (surgeon, CSO or pharmacist) only; engineering checks go in reviewEvidence. Design: docs/CLINICAL-CONTENT-UPGRADES.md.

reviewPolicy.note: No rule set has a documented clinical review in the repository, so every lastReviewed is "unknown". The nextReviewDue dates are PROPOSED first-review targets set on 2026-09-25 by priority (P1 = could directly change a diagnosis, dose, escalation or patient instruction; P2 = decision support with a clinician in the loop; P3 = reference catalogues). After a review, set lastReviewed and reviewer, and nextReviewDue = lastReviewed + intervalMonths (or sooner when the guideline body has a new edition due).

guidelines.citation: 8,316 of 14,358 features cite a source; 112 citations state an LR, of which 77 do not match the documented logLR = round(ln(LR) × 5) conversion

guidelines.citation: ICD-11 polyhierarchy + SNOMED CT concept model + AMA specialty taxonomy (matrix.authority)

ruleSets.reviewEvidence: None. Content added in batches 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-21 (58 commits); no clinical review recorded.
ruleSets.changeAuthority: Any repository committer (no CODEOWNERS). Ships only with an iOS app release (bundled resource).
ruleSets.notes: 161 pools, 1,232 candidates, 14,358 features, 6,136 distinct feature keys. logPrior has no recorded source and two scales (-46..+46 in most pools; -5.5..-0.5 in 17 pools). By static analysis the engine's Codable cannot decode the file (missing evidenceLabel, fractional logLR/logPrior, numeric feature values), so iOS silently uses ios-bayesian-fallback-candidates; confirm in Settings → Diagnostics.

ruleSets.title: Bayesian differential engine parameters (pool routing, urgency boost, score boosts, confidence bands, feature DAG discounting)
ruleSets.changeAuthority: Any repository committer. Ships with an iOS app release.
ruleSets.notes: Hand-set constants: urgency boost (urgency × 8), confirmed-diagnosis boost (+20), about 30 score-driven adjustments, confidence bands on logGap (25 / 15 / 7), pathognomonic threshold logLR ≥ 18, CPT discounting in BayesianFeatureNetwork. The softmax in topResults uses exp(logPosterior) although logLR is stored as 5 × ln(LR), so displayed percentages are far more extreme than the stated LRs imply. BayesianDecisionEngine+Database/Scoring/... duplicate the BayesianDiagnosisEngine extensions.
